correctness.rationale: For an outside vertex in part i, the distance multiset is completely determined by a_i=|W∩V_i|: it has a_i copies of 2 and |W|-a_i copies of 1. Thus adjacent outside vertices in distinct parts are distinguished exactly when their active occupancies differ. For k active parts, k distinct nonnegative occupancies have total at least binom(k,2); equality is feasible exactly when the sorted active part sizes satisfy m_j≥j. For fixed k the k largest parts dominate every other k-set in feasibility and saved size, yielding the formula. Boundary cases r=2 and all singleton parts agree with known results. Exhaustive direct-definition computation through order 11 found no mismatch.

value.rationale: Local outer multiset dimension was introduced recently, and its initiating paper explicitly identifies diameter-two graphs and joins as an open direction. Complete multipartite graphs are a canonical dense diameter-two/iterated-join class. The result gives both a full characterization of every resolving set and an exact formula for arbitrary part sizes, not merely a special case or a numerical table; it also shows a substantive separation from the global outer multiset invariant.
